name: James Ivings SaaS (PulseApp)
description: Build-in-public SaaS by James Ivings. June stats: $9,065 total revenue, $4,890 profit, $4,033 MRR (+12% from previous month). A multi-product SaaS studio approach.

name: Hirevire
description: Hiring tool SaaS by Sanat. Build-in-public stats Mar 2024: $57,911 total revenue (last 12 months), $4,381 revenue collected in March, $338 MRR. Automated video screening for hiring.

name: Olly's SaaS (Anonymous)
description: SaaS just had best month ever. July build-in-public: $11,455 total revenue (+40%), $9,103 MRR (+25%), 18.8K visits (+25%). Strong growth momentum.

name: SideProject reaching $1K MRR
description: Startup crossed $1K MRR after 4 months. $1,005.3 MRR, +35% month-over-month growth. Validates that SaaS can hit $1K MRR in under 6 months with focused execution.

name: HamsterBase
description: 本地优先的稍后读工具，支持Docker/iOS/Android/Windows/Linux/Mac六大平台。2023年收入$400 USD。正在集成离线AI embedding服务提升搜索能力。

name: PassLock 密码卫士
description: iOS/macOS密码管理器，支持自动填充密码，AES256+RSA加密，数据仅存储在本地或私人iCloud。具备订阅用户，开源策略（核心安全代码保留）。独立开发者作品。

name: SideProject-副业追踪
description: 帮助独立开发者追踪管理副业项目的App，展示投入时长、投入金额、净收入、ROI等关键指标。2024年SideProject类目自然流量表现一般，启示是下一款产品需要更广泛的受众。

name: Kuli Kuli 菜单翻译App
description: 出国时用的菜单翻译app。AI理解菜单能力比传统翻译更好。团队出品，专门做的一个小产品。已在App Store上架。解决点菜场景下的翻译痛点。

name: 好事发生App
description: 记录好事的App，新推出多肉呱呱主题。APP Store和安卓应用市场上架。免费+付费主题模式。创作者王梦珂，著有《把才华变成钱：一个人做品牌工作手册》。

name: LaserPecker 激光雕刻机
description: 消费级激光雕刻赛道头部。前华为工程师创立，2022年全球众筹累计突破3亿元，年销售额近5亿元。产品销往50+国家/地区，入驻沃尔玛。入门价2000元起，高阶款支持0.01mm精度。独立站转化率比亚马逊高30%。

name: hhacker's 独立产品
description: 独立开发者分享收费经验：打磨产品→筛选用户→最少投入。首次产品刚赚4位数。强调产品丝滑到一定程度用户会口口相传。AI时代独立开发属于新时代。

name: まみそ AIコーディングアシスタント
description: Web制作者向けのAIコーディングアシスタント。フリーランサー出身の開発者が現場ニーズに密着したツール開発で成功。月間数百万円の収益を達成。（日本独立开发者社区知名案例）

name: やまたく 飲食店予約管理システム
description: 飲食店向けの予約管理システムを個人で開発・運営。地域密着型アプローチで顧客との信頼関係を構築。大手システムとは異なる価値提供で成功。（日本MicroSaaS Hub案例）

name: Inkdrop (Markdownノート)
description: 日本人個人開発者Takuya Matsuyamaが開発したMarkdownノートアプリ。月額サブスクリプションモデル。開発者向けニッチ市場で安定した収益。個人開発者の成功事例として有名。

name: Skeb (イラストコミッション)
description: 日本発のイラストコミッション（有償依頼）プラットフォーム。クリエイターがリクエストを受けてイラストを制作・納品。手数料ビジネスモデル。月間取引高は億単位。

name: footyamigo.com (Football Data SaaS)
description: Profitable football data SaaS startup on Flippa: $41,930 (~$53K) revenue last 12 months, 69% profit margin, 223.9K/mo organic traffic. Subscription plans £24.99/month plus commission from strategy marketplace. Proven traction & growth potential.

name: AI SaaS (Flippa #12304317)
description: Profitable AI SaaS with 82% margins, $47.6K TTM revenue, $3.3K avg monthly profit, 170 subscribers and 570K email list. Powered by organic acquisition. Flippa vetted listing.

name: Thriving SaaS ($200K ARR)
description: Thriving SaaS business with $200K annual revenue, 28% profit margin. Mostly running on auto for last 2 years. Huge upside if done properly. Flippa vetted listing.

name: Education SaaS ($63K ARR)
description: Established SaaS business in Education with $63K ARR revenue, 70% profit margin, Domain Authority 24. Ideal for growth-oriented buyers. Flippa vetted.

name: Closet Tools (Chrome Extension - Poshmark)
description: Chrome Extension for Poshmark automation. Monthly revenue verified ~$42K on IndieHackers. Independent developer making money from a niche browser extension. Strong proof that single-purpose extensions can generate serious revenue.

name: GMass (Chrome Extension - Email)
description: Chrome extension for Gmail mass email campaigns. Creator lists revenue at $100K+ on IndieHackers (Aug 2020 verified). Freemium model with premium features at $1/month entry. Massive proof of Chrome extension revenue potential.

name: Friendly.is (Open Source Monetization)
description: Company making ~$100K ARR by bundling existing open source products into commercial offerings. Model: take open source, add hosting/support/enterprise features, charge subscription. Clean monetization play for developers.

name: Vercel Drop
description: Ranked #1 of the day on ProductHunt (June 13, 2026). Vercel's new product launch. File sharing/sending tool. Vercel ecosystem product with massive existing user base.

name: AirTrack Bot (Telegram)
description: Simple Telegram bot making $10,000/month. Flight tracking bot. Proves that niche Telegram bots can generate significant MRR with minimal overhead. Solo founder, zero ad spend.

name: Stagetimer
description: Micro SaaS for event timing/scheduling. Making $10K-$40K/month range. Browser-based countdown timer for conferences and events. Simple tool with clear value prop.
